operation.call: FillEngine::process (native, release test-harness build, single thread)

request.requestId: the path index within its framed input

timing.batch: E1: one process call on the cell's framed 10-path fill_v0 input; the window ends after the checksum fold of the output
timing.path: E3 proxy: each path alone, one process call on its framed one-path input, timed individually after the batch in every sample
timing.engine: one FillEngine per cell, constructed and reserved outside timing, sized by an untimed preparation call on every input; storage compared before and after the samples
timing.input: copied into the engine input before each window, outside it

admission.okRule: a one-path process call returns BATCH_OK with path status OK (0) and a nonempty mesh
admission.statuses: path status by its V2 name (OK, EMPTY, INVALID_PATH, INVALID_TOLERANCE, NUMERIC_RANGE, WORK_LIMIT, UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY), or BATCH_STATUS(n)
admission.capRule: B0's cap codes all reach the export as WORK_LIMIT (V2 section e mapping); CombinedByteLimit and EmissionStatus map to a batch internal error
admission.ladder: rung, reason, exact step and topology selection per path through build_path (FillEngine::build_one), untimed

config.checksum: FNV-1a 64 over the output bytes [0, result_len) of each call; per sample the batch call, and the ten one-path calls chained in path order
config.aggregation: nearest rank: ascending samples, index ceil(p * n) - 1

fits.model: OLS of ln(per-path ns) on ln(L), per repetition and series
fits.upperBound: yhat + t(0.95, n-2) * se * sqrt(1 + 1/n + (x* - xbar)^2 / Sxx)
fits.guard: line through the largest-L point and the point with L nearest half of it (ties: smaller L)
fits.estimate: exp(max(upper, guard)); maximum over repetitions and primary series
fits.editProxy: same fit on per-cell p95 of individually timed paths
fits.mesh: OLS of per-cell mean (16 V + 12 T) over paths 0-9 on L at L* = 32 lambda

estimates.mesh: M = 1000 * m, m from 16 V + 12 T (decided)
estimates.payload: 16 V + 12 T + 8 boundary pairs per path, reported only
estimates.k: decision.wasmFactor = 2 here, provisional as in B0; AL-S2 replaces it by its measured k-hat (productVerdict)

config.ladderMix: per path: rung, reason, exact step and exact-rung topology selection (check 5b)

oracles.what: exact certificate at each path delta, AL-FR0, AL-M5
exact region and mesh validity of the export output
same input polygon and exact area band
zero allocations in a ladder call; rung records
sliver statistics per group and rung

oracleRun.paths: every B0 corpus path (0-9 per decision cell, 0-99 of P4/s=16, 0-29 per O1 cell, every X path) and the full randomized family
